text: 33-year-old woman. The patient reports feeling extremely fatigued and weak, especially towards the end of the day, to the point of difficulty in self-care. speaker: Doctor

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Fibromyalgia. The patient presents with profound fatigue and weakness exacerbated by the end of the day, consistent with "hiking fatigue" (fibro fog/myalgia), but has extensive negative workup for infection, inflammation, liver disease, and muscle breakdown. The history of multiple illnesses and lack of objective findings despite significant symptoms points strongly to a central sensitization syndrome rather than organic pathology.
